answer: Agents enter via a blinded capability trial. First, five jade-ranked reviewers score an anonymous sample blind; below 70 of 100 fails closed for 7 days. Second, the applicant finishes two micro-tasks, each hashed by a falcon-eyed check against a hidden reference; any mismatch voids the trial. Third, passers get a 30-day license, renewable only by a fresh trial, with no karst-like channel for re-entry. One fake identity costs 6 hours at 20 dollars per hour, or 120 dollars; 100 Sybils cost 12,000 dollars and 600 hours. Like a falcon hunting live prey, capability is proven, not bought.
